scheme_name: Mandahasam Scheme To Provide Artificial Dentures To Senior Citizens
description:
The Mandahasam Scheme is an initiative launched by the Government of Tamil Nadu to provide artificial dentures to senior citizens.

This scheme was officially launched on 1st October 2021.

The primary objective of the Mandahasam Scheme is to enhance the quality of life for elderly individuals by addressing dental health issues.

The scheme aims to provide free artificial dentures to senior citizens aged 60 years and above.

The Tamil Nadu government has set a target to benefit approximately 1.5 lakh senior citizens annually under this scheme.

The Mandahasam Scheme is part of the broader initiative to improve health services for the elderly population in the state.

The scheme recognizes that many elderly individuals suffer from dental problems that significantly affect their ability to eat and communicate.

By providing artificial dentures, the scheme aims to restore their confidence and improve their overall well-being.

Eligible beneficiaries must be residents of Tamil Nadu and must be aged 60 years or older.

There are no specific income criteria mentioned for eligibility under the Mandahasam Scheme.

Senior citizens who require dental assistance can apply for the scheme through designated government hospitals and health centers.

The application process involves filling out a form that is available at these health facilities.

Applicants must provide proof of age, such as an Aadhaar card or birth certificate.

Additionally, they may need to submit a recent photograph and any relevant medical records that indicate the need for dentures.

Once the application is submitted, the health officials will assess the need for dentures.

The assessment will include a dental examination conducted by qualified dental professionals.

After the assessment, eligible beneficiaries will be issued a prescription for artificial dentures.

The dentures are then fabricated and provided to the beneficiaries at no cost.

The scheme covers the entire cost of the dentures, ensuring that financial constraints do not hinder access to dental care.

The Mandahasam Scheme aims to ensure that the dentures provided are of high quality and suitable for the beneficiaries.

The frequency of the disbursement of dentures is based on the assessment and need of the individual.

There is no specific timeline mentioned for the disbursement process as it is contingent upon the completion of the assessment.

The implementing authority for the Mandahasam Scheme is the Department of Public Health and Preventive Medicine in Tamil Nadu.

The health department has set up a dedicated team to oversee the implementation of this scheme.

Contact details for inquiries can be obtained from the local health centers or the official website of the Tamil Nadu government.

The Mandahasam Scheme is part of a larger framework of welfare schemes aimed at supporting the elderly population in Tamil Nadu.

The government has allocated a budget of ₹10 crore for the implementation of this scheme in its initial year.

This allocation is expected to cover the costs associated with the production and distribution of dentures.

The scheme also aims to create awareness among senior citizens about the importance of dental health.

Awareness programs are conducted in various localities to educate the elderly about the services available under the Mandahasam Scheme.

The scheme is expected to reduce the stigma associated with dental issues among senior citizens.

It encourages them to seek help and improve their dental health without the fear of financial burden.

The Mandahasam Scheme aligns with the National Policy on Older Persons, which emphasizes the need for health care services for the elderly.

The government aims to create a supportive environment for senior citizens through this initiative.

In addition to providing dentures, the scheme also promotes regular dental check-ups for the elderly.

Regular check-ups can help in the early detection of dental issues and prevent further complications.

The Mandahasam Scheme is a significant step towards ensuring that the elderly population in Tamil Nadu receives adequate health care.

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries who have reported improved quality of life after receiving dentures.

The government is committed to continuously monitoring and evaluating the effectiveness of the Mandahasam Scheme.

This evaluation will help in making necessary adjustments to improve the service delivery.

The scheme is part of the Tamil Nadu government's broader initiative to promote geriatric care.

It reflects the government's commitment to addressing the unique health challenges faced by the elderly population.

The Mandahasam Scheme is expected to serve as a model for similar initiatives in other states across India.

By providing free dentures, the scheme not only addresses health issues but also promotes social inclusion for senior citizens.

The government encourages family members of senior citizens to assist them in applying for the scheme.

This support can help ensure that more elderly individuals benefit from the services offered.

The Mandahasam Scheme is a testament to the government's recognition of the rights and needs of senior citizens.

It emphasizes the importance of providing comprehensive health care services to enhance their quality of life.

The scheme is expected to contribute significantly to the overall health and well-being of the elderly population in Tamil Nadu.

In conclusion, the Mandahasam Scheme is a vital initiative aimed at improving dental health among senior citizens.

It provides free artificial dentures to eligible individuals, ensuring that financial constraints do not prevent access to necessary dental care.

Through this scheme, the Tamil Nadu government aims to enhance the quality of life for its elderly citizens and promote their well-being.
